caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest rendered in shades of brown with detailed wood grain texture visible throughout its surface. The chest has a rectangular shape with a flat lid and stands on four sturdy legs. The front panel features intricate carved designs that include symmetrical scrollwork and vertical rectangular panels. The top edge of the front panel, just below the lid, has a horizontal band with additional carved wavy patterns. The wood appears aged, with the texture and color variations highlighting the natural appearance of the material. The chest is positioned on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or decorations around it.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
